tools.description: Owner-only bounded management of an abnormal verification task, not a recursive asynchronous task. Each reliably persisted result, including insufficient evidence, consumes request_id; the same ID replays its historical result without re-inspecting. A new ID is needed for fresh evidence. Checks registered local execution exclusion and durable finish separately; may close only the verification task, never the original business task or its claims. Missing/unregistered runtime proof retains protection. No force/evidence flags, waiting, implicit retry or production source approval.

tools.description: Explicit asynchronous inspection of durable publication evidence for an unresolved market task. Reads fixed SQLite publication versions, receipts and projections; missing receipt is insufficient evidence, not proof of failure. The separate check never publishes, changes heads or releases the original task claims. A prior all-recorded conclusion can bind a new request without a new inspection. Inspect publication_check via get_task_progress. Corrupt evidence and interrupted inspections retain protection; no caller approval or force flags. This ready interface does not make the official data source production-ready.

tools.description: Explicit asynchronous verification of a proven local coverage gap in one published QFQ daily version. The caller names only symbol/day/[start,end]; the subject head is frozen at acceptance and re-checked at decision commit. items.description: Owner-only bounded management of an abnormal verification task, not a recursive asynchronous task. Each reliably persisted result, including insufficient evidence, consumes request_id; the same ID replays its historical result without re-inspecting. A new ID is needed for fresh evidence. Checks registered local execution exclusion and durable finish separately; may close only the verification task, never the original business task or its claims. Missing/unregistered runtime proof retains protection. No force/evidence flags, waiting, implicit retry or production source approval.

items.declared_scope: DECLARED_SCOPE: owner personal research, local-only, no external exposure (#71 comment-5749934485); overall production certification pending #225
items.description: Explicit asynchronous inspection of durable publication evidence for an unresolved market task. Reads fixed SQLite publication versions, receipts and projections; missing receipt is insufficient evidence, not proof of failure. The separate check never publishes, changes heads or releases the original task claims. A prior all-recorded conclusion can bind a new request without a new inspection. Inspect publication_check via get_task_progress. Corrupt evidence and interrupted inspections retain protection; no caller approval or force flags. This ready interface does not make the official data source production-ready.

items.declared_scope: DECLARED_SCOPE: owner personal research, local-only, no external exposure (#71 comment-5749934485); overall production certification pending #225
items.description: Explicit asynchronous stopping-evidence inspection of a task awaiting verification. Admission preserves original claims. The installed verifier can prove an audited revision-zero task never started using verified SQLite facts and conditional exclusion of a later claim. Started or unsupported executions remain STOP_EVIDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED; no caller assertion, PID absence or old run identity can unlock a task. Inspect the separate check conclusion via get_task_progress.

blocking_reasons.detail: no installed inspected official snapshot; executions record per-item source refusals and never advance heads (X_DATA_MCP_OFFICIAL_MANIFEST + X_DATA_MCP_OFFICIAL_DIR with a passing manifest)

items.declared_scope: DECLARED_SCOPE: owner personal research, local-only, no external exposure (#71 comment-5749934485); overall production certification pending #225
items.description: Explicit asynchronous verification of a proven local coverage gap in one published QFQ daily version. The caller names only symbol/day/[start,end]; the subject head is frozen at acceptance and re-checked at decision commit. Decisions come only from the installed trusted source-gap verifier; source limitation or unavailability never produces a proven gap, and a decision never triggers update/backfill by itself. Proving a gap requires the verified active generation (or the installed inspected snapshot in legacy mode); without one runtime readiness is blocked and no gap can be proven.

blocking_reasons.detail: no installed inspected official snapshot; executions record per-item source refusals and never advance heads (X_DATA_MCP_OFFICIAL_MANIFEST + X_DATA_MCP_OFFICIAL_DIR with a passing manifest)

items.description: Local-owner explicit market.daily republish (#247): republishes a fixed base version as a new version through the same verified pipeline, authorized by this command itself — not by frozen proven gaps.
